post.summary: Extract a CV file (PDF or DOCX, at most 5 MiB) as Markdown for review. The file and text are held encrypted under importId for at most 24 hours, until PUT /me/cv uses them. A new import replaces the pending one. A file whose extracted text is over the CV limit gets 413.

parameters.name: X-Integrity-Token
parameters.description: Play Integrity token. Optional in this draft. Phase 3, which ships Play Integrity, makes it required: a missing or failed token then gets 403 INTEGRITY_FAILED.

file.description: PDF or DOCX, at most 5242880 bytes.

restructure.description: Ask AI to restructure the text. Needs Google sign-in, and an entitlement or the trial. Without it, the server extracts plain text. AI ships in phase 3; until then, true gets 403 ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED.
